name: Marin
source:
A mysterious girl that appears in a dream and calls the protagonist to her world in the future.

Information regarding this individual is classified as top secret by the Federal Intelligence Agency and the Scientific Investigation Bureau, treating them as a Level 1 high-priority individual...
